t: 威灵顿公爵所指挥的英国军队袭击了巴达霍兹的要塞. 这将是反对拿破仑领导的法国的半岛战争的转折点.
te: British forces under the command of the Duke of Wellington assault the fortress of Badajoz. This would be the turning p…
dz: 威灵顿公爵所指挥的英国军队袭击了巴达霍兹的要塞. 这将是反对拿破仑领导的法国的半岛战争的转折点.
de: British forces under the command of the Duke of Wellington assault the fortress of Badajoz. This would be the turning point in the Peninsular War against Napoleon-led France.

t: 约翰·雅各布·阿斯特 (John Jacob Astor) 合并了美国毛皮公司，这最终使他成为…
te: John Jacob Astor incorporates the American Fur Company, that would eventually make him America's first millionaire.
dz: 约翰·雅各布·阿斯特 (John Jacob Astor) 合并了美国毛皮公司，这最终使他成为美国第一位百万富翁。
de: John Jacob Astor incorporates the American Fur Company, that would eventually make him America's first millionaire.

t: 君士坦丁堡条约建立了塞普特岛共和国,这是自拜占庭帝国倒台以来第一个自治的希腊国家. (在"旧式…
te: The Treaty of Constantinople establishes the Septinsular Republic, the first autonomous Greek state since the Fall of t…
dz: 君士坦丁堡条约建立了塞普特岛共和国,这是自拜占庭帝国倒台以来第一个自治的希腊国家. (在"旧式历"下,后来仍在奥斯曼帝国使用,条约于3月21日签署. )
de: The Treaty of Constantinople establishes the Septinsular Republic, the first autonomous Greek state since the Fall of the Byzantine Empire. (Under the Old Style calendar then still in use in the Ottoman Empire, the treaty was signed on 21 March.)

t: 法国大革命期间，公共安全委员会成为共和国的执行机关。
te: During the French Revolution, the Committee of Public Safety becomes the executive organ of the republic.
dz: 法国大革命期间，公共安全委员会成为共和国的执行机关。
de: During the French Revolution, the Committee of Public Safety becomes the executive organ of the republic.

t: 暹罗（现代泰国）佛陀 Yodfa Chulaloke（拉玛一世）建立却克里王朝。
te: King Buddha Yodfa Chulaloke (Rama I) of Siam (modern day Thailand) establishes the Chakri dynasty.
dz: 暹罗（现代泰国）佛陀 Yodfa Chulaloke（拉玛一世）建立却克里王朝。
de: King Buddha Yodfa Chulaloke (Rama I) of Siam (modern day Thailand) establishes the Chakri dynasty.

t: 大陆海军舰艇试图捕获一艘皇家海军派遣船，但失败。
te: Ships of the Continental Navy fail in their attempt to capture a Royal Navy dispatch boat.
dz: 美国独立战争：大陆海军舰艇试图捕获一艘皇家海军派遣船，但失败。
de: American Revolutionary War: Ships of the Continental Navy fail in their attempt to capture a Royal Navy dispatch boat.

t: 1712年纽约奴隶革命从百老汇附近开始.
te: The New York Slave Revolt of 1712 begins near Broadway.
dz: 1712年纽约奴隶革命从百老汇附近开始.
de: The New York Slave Revolt of 1712 begins near Broadway.

t: 在好望角，荷兰水手 Jan van Riebeeck 建立了一个补给营，最终成为开普敦。
te: At the Cape of Good Hope, Dutch sailor Jan van Riebeeck establishes a resupply camp that eventually becomes Cape Town.
dz: 在好望角，荷兰水手 Jan van Riebeeck 建立了一个补给营，最终成为开普敦。
de: At the Cape of Good Hope, Dutch sailor Jan van Riebeeck establishes a resupply camp that eventually becomes Cape Town.

t: 英国历史上记录到的最大地震之一,佛兰德斯或法国北部也发生.
te: One of the largest earthquakes recorded in the history of England, Flanders, or Northern France, takes place.
dz: 英国历史上记录到的最大地震之一,佛兰德斯或法国北部也发生.
de: One of the largest earthquakes recorded in the history of England, Flanders, or Northern France, takes place.

t: 迈赫迈德二世开始围攻君士坦丁堡. 该市于5月29日倒塌并更名为伊斯坦布尔.
te: Mehmed II begins his siege of Constantinople. The city falls on May 29 and is renamed Istanbul.
dz: 迈赫迈德二世开始围攻君士坦丁堡. 该市于5月29日倒塌并更名为伊斯坦布尔.
de: Mehmed II begins his siege of Constantinople. The city falls on May 29 and is renamed Istanbul.

t: 苏格兰人通过签署"阿布鲁斯宣言"来重申他们的独立性.
te: The Scots reaffirm their independence by signing the Declaration of Arbroath.
dz: 苏格兰人通过签署"阿布鲁斯宣言"来重申他们的独立性.
de: The Scots reaffirm their independence by signing the Declaration of Arbroath.

t: 拜占庭皇帝君士坦丁七世加冕他的儿子罗曼诺斯二世为同族.
te: Byzantine Emperor Constantine VII crowns his son Romanos II as co-emperor.
dz: 拜占庭皇帝君士坦丁七世加冕他的儿子罗曼诺斯二世为同族.
de: Byzantine Emperor Constantine VII crowns his son Romanos II as co-emperor.

t: 斯地利乔在波伦提亚战役中击败了阿拉里克手下的维西哥特人.
te: Stilicho defeats the Visigoths under Alaric in the Battle of Pollentia.
dz: 斯地利乔在波伦提亚战役中击败了阿拉里克手下的维西哥特人.
de: Stilicho defeats the Visigoths under Alaric in the Battle of Pollentia.

t: 尤利乌斯·凯撒在塔普苏斯战役中击败了克西利乌斯·梅特勒斯·斯西皮奥和马库斯·波尔西乌斯·卡托(…
te: Julius Caesar defeats Caecilius Metellus Scipio and Marcus Porcius Cato (Cato the Younger) at the Battle of Thapsus.
dz: 尤利乌斯·凯撒在塔普苏斯战役中击败了克西利乌斯·梅特勒斯·斯西皮奥和马库斯·波尔西乌斯·卡托(英语:Marcus Porcius Cato (Cato the Younger)).
de: Julius Caesar defeats Caecilius Metellus Scipio and Marcus Porcius Cato (Cato the Younger) at the Battle of Thapsus.
